title: Translator extension list entry
description: One file per extension: extensions/<id>.json. Translator reads index.json, which is built from these files.

id.description: The id in the extension's adapter.json; the file name is <id>.json.

summary.description: One or two sentences: which files it translates and what it leaves alone.

extensions.description: File extensions without the dot, as in adapter.json.

min_app_version.description: Lowest Translator version it needs; empty for any.

download.description: Where the zip can be downloaded, tried in order; every address must serve the same file.

size.description: Size of the zip in bytes.

status.description: official: maintained by the Translator project. reviewed: reviewed and accepted.

reviewed_at.description: Date of the review (YYYY-MM-DD), filled in on merge.

reviewed_by.description: Who reviewed it, filled in on merge.
